current_difficulty_reason: The prior existence and contraction formulas for the natural flow do not themselves force a quotient containing a compact analytic set to preserve a complex geodesic. The authored proof uses calibrated volume minimality to rule out strict contraction, turns trace equality on every limit-set direction into a single complex tangent line, and then localizes the analytic set in the invariant geodesic quotient. Showing that this quotient must be compact supplies the global rigidity obligation beyond the precise prior flow and comparison foundations.
